business_scope.primary_industry_name: Manufacture of Turbine-Driven Critical Care Invasive Ventilators

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Code monétaire et financier (Law No. 2016-1691 of 9 December 2016 on transparency, the fight against corruption and the modernisation of economic life, as amended by Law No. 2022-172 of 14 March 2022) and EU Directive 2015/849; UBO register governed by Articles L. 821-1 et seq. of the Code de commerce.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent authority in country of origin

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory PEP, OFAC SDN, UN, EU and French domestic sanctions screening per AMF and ACPR standards

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: infogreffe.fr (Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: French language using Latin alphabet; no transliteration required

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: French Commercial Code (Code de commerce) Articles L.227-1 to L.227-4 (SAS constitution and capital), L.227-5 to L.227-19 (governance and powers of the President), and R.224-3 (RCS filing formalities); implemented jointly with Ordinance No. 2023-393 on the single business formalities portal (guichet unique des formalités d'entreprises).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Guichet unique des formalités d'entreprises operated by the INPI (Institut National de la Propriété Industrielle), forwarding the dossier to the Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS) kept at the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce of the registered office's court district (for Paris: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce de Paris).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Formulaire M0 (CERFA n° 11680) - Declaration of Creation of a Commercial Company (Déclaration de création d'une société), filed electronic-only through the INPI guichet unique portal.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum share capital for a French SAS; the articles freely fix the amount, which must be fully subscribed. Cash contributions must be released on incorporation to at least 50% of nominal value where capital equals or exceeds EUR 37,000, otherwise to at least one-fifth under the SARL regime (Art. L.223-7), with the balance payable within five years. Paid-in cash must be deposited in a blocked account (compte bloqué) at a licensed French credit institution; the bank's attestation de dépôt de fonds is filed with the RCS dossier and funds are released only after registration. In-kind contributions require a statutory auditor's valuation report (commissaire aux apports) unless waived by unanimous shareholders.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION OF FR_SAS. The shareholders, acting unanimously under Article 15 of the statutes, resolve: (i) the share capital of Euro 100,000 is fixed, divided into 10,000 ordinary shares of Euro 10 nominal value each, fully subscribed and paid in; shares are allotted to the subscribing shareholders recorded in the subscription table; (ii) the registered office is adopted at 8 Avenue Kléber, 75116 Paris, France; (iii) [PRÉSIDENT] is appointed President (Président) of the company with the full powers granted by Article L.227-6 of the Code de commerce; (iv) the President is authorized to open bank accounts, publish the required legal notice, file the M0 declaration with the INPI Guichet Unique and complete every registration and licensing formality.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting, Execution and Signature of the Articles of Association (Statuts)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Company legal counsel; optional notaire (notarial deed mandatory only when a contribution consists of real property or a business going concern, otherwise private deed under seing privé).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the statuts with all SAS mandatory clauses: corporate name, legal form, registered office, corporate object (manufacture and sale of turbine-driven invasive mechanical ventilators for ICU), duration (99 years), capital, share transfer restrictions, governance, powers of the President, and optional statutory auditor clause. Verify corporate name availability via the INPI corporate name database; obtain the consent of the designated President and of each shareholder; have all parties initial every page and sign the final signature page, or execute a notarial act where required.
required_dossiers: Passport or national ID of each shareholder and each officer
Proof of residential address dated less than three months for shareholders and officers
INPI corporate name availability search result
Signed draft statutes (statuts) in French
Notarial deed if real-property or business contribution is made
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name search reveals a conflict or the registry objects to the corporate name, adopt a revised name by supplementary resolution before filing. If the statuts contain a substantive defect, execute a rectifying resolution (résolution de rectification) signed by all shareholders prior to the M0 submission.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Opening of the Blocked Capital Deposit Account and Issuance of Bank Certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed French credit institution (bank) selected by the founders, e.g. BNP Paribas or Société Générale, corporate banking desk.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a blocked funds account (compte de dépôt des fonds) in the name of the company 'en formation' (FR_SAS in formation). Each subscribing shareholder transfers or deposits the subscribed cash amount into the account. The bank verifies KYC/AML documentation, blocks the funds, and issues the attestation de dépôt de fonds (certificate of deposit of paid-up capital) in a statutory form; the certificate must state the exact paid-in amount and confirm that funds are blocked until production of the Kbis extract.
required_dossiers: Provisional signed statutes
Identity documents of all subscriber shareholders
Proof of address documents
KYC/AML forms and beneficial ownership declaration
Documentation on the source of funds (anti-money laundering)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank raises KYC deficiencies or refuses the account, provide the requested corporate and shareholder documentation in corrected form and resubmit; the attestation will be re-issued by the bank once the file is regularized. Any amendment of the contributions requires a new blocking operation and a fresh certificate.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Publication of the Legal Notice (Avis de Constitution) in an Authorized Legal Journal
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Journal d'annonces légales (JAL) authorized in the département of the registered office - for a Paris registered office, a Paris-area authorized legal gazette (e.g., Affiches Parisiennes) or an online approved legal publication service.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare and submit the notice content in French: corporate name, legal form (SAS), share capital, registered office address, corporate purpose (manufacture and sale of ICU invasive mechanical ventilators), duration, name and address of the President. Pay the publication fee, verify proof of the notice, and obtain the attestation de parution (certificate of publication) dated and signed by the JAL; this certificate remains valid for RCS filing for six months and must be included in the incorporation dossier.
required_dossiers: Extract of the statutes with corporate data for publication
Statement from the legal representative confirming the officers to be published
Power of attorney if a counsel places the notice on behalf of the company
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the published notice contains an error or is challenged as incomplete, arrange a corrective re-publication (avis rectificatif) in the same or another authorized JAL and obtain a fresh attestation de parution before the RCS filing deadline.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of the Sole Incorporation Declaration (Formulaire M0) via the INPI Guichet Unique
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: INPI Guichet unique des formalités d'entreprises (https://formalites.entreprises.inpi.fr); the declaration is then transmitted to the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce de Paris for the RCS registration.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Create an account on the INPI guichet unique portal; select 'création d'une société commerciale (SAS)'; complete the M0 form fields including corporate name, registered office, legal form, share capital, presidents and directors, beneficial owner declaration (déclaration des bénéficiaires effectifs) and exercise of the medical-device manufacturing activity; upload the signed statutes and all mandatory annexes in PDF; pay the official filing fee by electronic payment; submit the dossier. The portal issues an electronic acknowledgement of receipt; the greffe must register the company or request completion within the legal 10-day period (extendable).
required_dossiers: Signed statutes in duly stamped or electronic form
Bank attestation de dépôt de fonds (paid-up capital certificate)
JAL attestation de parution (legal notice publication certificate)
Identity document of the President, directors and each shareholder
Declaration of beneficial owners (beneficial ownership register requirement)
Power of attorney if the filing is made by an agent or counsel
Proof of the registered-address premises (occupancy title or lease)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the greffe issues an 'injonction de régularisation' (notice of incomplete dossier), the applicant has 15 days to complete and resubmit the missing documents through the same guichet unique portal. If the period is missed, the application is rejected and a fresh M0 filing must be initiated. A motivated refusal may be contested before the public prosecutor attached to the Tribunal de Commerce (ministère public).

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration with the Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés and Issuance of the Kbis Extract
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce de Paris (RCS registration desk); INSEE (Institut National de la Statistique et des Études Économiques) assigns the SIREN and SIRET identifiers upon validation.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After the guichet unique validation, the greffe registers FR_SAS in the RCS and allocates the RCS registration number; INSEE subsequently attributes the SIREN identifier and the SIRET code for the registered establishment. The greffe delivers the Kbis extract (extrait d'immatriculation au registre du commerce et des sociétés), which is the official identity certificate of the company proving its legal existence; the company acquires legal personality with full capacity as of the date of registration. The President retrieves the Kbis and the RCS number and verifies all lodged data.
required_dossiers: No additional documents: registration data generated from the accepted M0 dossier and annexes
Confirmation of payment of the official filing fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Kbis or RCS data displays an error in the registered office, capital, officer names or address, file a rectification request with the greffe (supplemented by a rectifying resolution or corrected certificate); the greffe must correct the registry entry without re-opening incorporation. If registration is refused, the refusal order may be appealed before the President of the Tribunal de Commerce within 10 days of notification.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Registration Notification to URSSAF, DGFiP and CCI and Opening of Tax and Social Accounts
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: URSSAF Île-de-France (social security registration); Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) - Service des Impôts des Entreprises (SIE) of the registered office district; CCI Paris Île-de-France (mandatory registration of merchants and commercial companies).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The guichet unique automatically notifies URSSAF, DGFiP, INSEE and CCI of the registration; verify that the SIREN/SIRET records are consistent. Register the President as assimilated salaried employee under the French general social security scheme; obtain the URSSAF attestation de vigilance; open the corporate income tax (IS), VAT (TVA) and territorial economic contribution (CFE) accounts with the competent SIE; present the Kbis to the bank to release the blocked capital funds. If any officer is an extra-EU resident, ensure the applicable residence/work formalities for exercising the mandate are initiated separately at the prefecture.
required_dossiers: Kbis extract (official company identity certificate)
Articles of association
Identity documents of the President and officers
Bank details (RIB) of the company
URSSAF and DGFiP registration forms generated electronically
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If URSSAF or DGFiP credentials are not delivered within the SLA, contact the guichet unique helpline (INPI) to request reactivation of the notification chain; if SIRET is missing, ask INSEE to re-transmit; late receipt of credentials does not suspend the legal filing deadlines for the first tax declarations.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: ANSM (Agence nationale de sécurité du médicament et des produits de santé) for medical-device manufacturer obligations in France; DREETS Île-de-France (Direction régionale de l'économie, de l'emploi, du travail et des solidarités) for workplace and occupational safety; DRIEAT (Direction régionale et interdépartementale de l'environnement, de l'aménagement et des transports) for environmental and ICPE (Installations classées pour la protection de l'environnement) compliance in the Paris region.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: CE technical conformity under EU Regulation 2017/745 (MDR) with Class IIb classification for the invasive ICU mechanical ventilator, coupled with ANSM manufacturer registration (enregistrement d'activité de fabricant) and federal vigilance obligations; facility operating declaration (déclaration d'ouverture d'établissement) filed with the competent DREETS/DRIEAT and local authorities for the industrial and assembly premises.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: DRIEAT Île-de-France - Inspection des Installations Classées pour la Protection de l'Environnement, Ministry of Ecological Transition and Territorial Cohesion; local commune/prefecture for urbanism and water law declarations.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Full EIA is not triggered for low-impact electronics and mechanical assembly of ventilators. Where ancillary operations are installed (e.g., solvent-based cleaning, autoclave sterilization, compressor/test benches), the facility becomes subject to the ICPE 'déclaration' or, if thresholds are exceeded, 'enregistrement' regime (e.g., ICPE rubrique 2925 for solvent use, rubrique 2681 for sterilization). The operator files an environmental registration dossier with DRIEAT and a water-law declaration under Articles L.214-1 et seq. of the Code de l'Environnement if wastewater discharge is requested.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater: compliance with Articles L.210-1 and L.214-1 of the Code de l'Environnement and the municipal sewer permit; no discharge of organic solvents, AOX or heavy metals without pre-treatment; pH between 5.5 and 8.5, suspended solids and COD within the annex thresholds of the applicable arrêté préfectoral. Air/VOCs: solvent consumption below 2 Mg/year threshold before IED full-BAT applies; vented solvent concentration not to exceed 20 mg C/m³; compliance with general ELVs of the 2010/75/EU Directive transposed in the French arrêtés. Waste: mandatory five-stream sorting (paper, metal, plastic, glass, wood), GEREP reporting to ADEME for waste declarations, and consignment of hazardous and biomedical waste to licensed carriers under the waste-traceability decrees.
required_dossiers: ICPE declaration or registration dossier
Water-law declaration if wastewater discharge is made
Waste management and tracking plan
ADEME/GEREP annual emission declaration
Environmental noise and air emission measurement reports

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety: conformity certificate delivered by the local Service Départemental d'Incendie et de Secours (SDIS) upon inspection of the production facility, including emergency exits, extinguishing systems, and storage of lithium batteries/electron components. Structural clearance: load-bearing verification certificate issued by a licensed civil engineering office confirming floor capacity for the ventilation test benches and machining equipment. Occupational clearance: inspection by DREETS Île-de-France covering CE-marked machinery, electrical installation conformity, machine guarding, and air quality in assembly and test rooms; approval of the CSE (Comité Social et Économique) health and safety rules and the unique risk assessment document (document unique d'évaluation des risques) required under the Code du travail.
required_dossiers: SDIS fire inspection certificate
Structural load verification note by a design office
DREETS occupational inspection report
Document unique d'évaluation des risques (DUER)
CE declaration of conformity of production machinery
Electrical installation conformity certificate

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction générale des Finances publiques (DGFiP), principally through the relevant Service des impôts des entreprises (SIE); non-established businesses generally deal with the Service des impôts des entreprises étrangères (SIEE). The principal online portal is impots.gouv.fr, including the professional area (Espace professionnel).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A French SAS is registered through the business formalities portal operated by the Institut national de la propriété industrielle (INPI). Following registration in the Registre national des entreprises and, where applicable, the Registre du commerce et des sociétés, it receives a SIREN and establishment-level SIRET. The competent SIE assigns or confirms the corporate tax account and French VAT identification number, generally in the format FR plus a two-digit key and the nine-digit SIREN. The company must activate its DGFiP professional account and comply with electronic filing and payment requirements. A foreign entity without a French establishment that makes transactions requiring French VAT registration applies to the SIEE, providing formation documents, proof of business activity, identification and transaction information. Such a taxable person generally has no French VAT turnover threshold. A non-EU-established business may be required to appoint a French VAT fiscal representative unless an applicable mutual assistance arrangement or statutory exception removes that requirement.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: A SAS is ordinarily subject to French corporate income tax (impôt sur les sociétés). A qualifying newly formed company may elect temporary partnership-style income taxation under Article 239 bis AB of the French Tax Code, generally for no more than five financial years, subject to ownership, activity, size and age conditions; the election is unavailable to a company whose shares are listed. This is not a US-style check-the-box election. France has no general elective hybrid-mismatch classification regime; anti-hybrid rules implementing EU ATAD provisions may deny deductions or require income inclusion in specified cross-border arrangements.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT; taxe sur la valeur ajoutée, TVA), harmonized under EU VAT law and administered in France by the DGFiP.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No general turnover threshold applies to an ordinary taxable business, including a non-established taxable person, once it makes transactions for which French VAT registration is required. Eligible France-established small businesses may use the VAT exemption regime (franchise en base) subject to applicable turnover limits; the generally applicable thresholds are EUR 85,000 for supplies of goods and EUR 37,500 for services, with separate prior-year/current-year rules and activity-specific exceptions. Thresholds and eligibility should be checked for the relevant tax year.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: France does not generally operate a real-time VAT invoice clearance or digital-stamping system. Under the enacted domestic B2B reform, businesses must be able to receive electronic invoices from 1 September 2026; issuance obligations apply from that date to large and intermediate-sized enterprises and from 1 September 2027 to SMEs and micro-enterprises. Covered domestic B2B invoices must be exchanged through a registered private platform (plateforme agréée) or the public platform designated by law, with required invoice data transmitted to the tax administration. E-reporting applies to specified B2C and cross-border transactions. These rules do not make export customs declarations subject to VAT invoice pre-clearance.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of goods dispatched or transported from France to a destination outside the EU may be exempt with the right to deduct input VAT under Article 262 I of the French Tax Code, provided the statutory exporter and documentary conditions are met and exit from the EU customs territory is evidenced. A supply of services is not automatically a zero-rated export: its VAT treatment depends on place-of-supply rules, customer status and any applicable exemption or special rule. Services whose place of supply is outside France are generally outside the scope of French VAT, subject to reporting and evidence requirements. Input VAT refund or deduction requires valid supporting records and a direct link to taxable or otherwise credit-preserving activities.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Export customs declaration and MRN, together with electronic confirmation of exit from the EU customs territory where available
Commercial invoice, sales contract or purchase order identifying the goods, parties, price and destination
Transport evidence appropriate to the route, such as bill of lading, air waybill, CMR, carrier receipt or proof of delivery
Evidence identifying the exporter of record and linking the declared goods to the invoiced supply
For services, contract, customer VAT or business-status evidence where relevant, deliverables and records supporting the place-of-supply treatment
Bank remittance records where available as corroboration; an inward remittance certificate is not a general French statutory condition for export exemption
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: France imposes no general statutory foreign-exchange repatriation deadline for export proceeds. The exporter must retain reliable records supporting export, transport, customer, invoicing and VAT-return treatment and produce them during a DGFiP audit. If exemption or deduction is unsupported, the administration may assess output VAT, deny or recover input VAT deductions, charge late-payment interest and apply tax penalties. Depending on the breach and intent, penalties may include the 5% penalty for specified invoicing or reporting failures, 40% for deliberate non-compliance, 80% for fraudulent manoeuvres or concealed activity, and criminal sanctions for tax fraud. Applicable rates depend on the facts, statutory provision and procedure; a good-faith correction may affect penalties.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque de France (Eurosystem member) is the central bank responsible for monetary stability, balance-of-payments statistics, and oversight of French payment and settlement systems, including TARGET2 participation. Foreign-exchange control and capital-movement regulation are administered through the Ministry of the Economy and Finance (Direction Generale du Tresor) under the Code monetaire et financier, while banking prudential and AML/CFT supervision is delegated to the ACPR (Autorite de Controle Prudentiel et de Resolution).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: France maintains full current-account and capital-account convertibility of the euro under Articles 63-66 TFEU. There are no exchange-control approvals, currency licences, surrender obligations, or quantitative restrictions on euro or foreign-currency payments. For the French SAS manufacturing ICU ventilators, practical frictions are not convertibility but (i) balance-of-payments statistical declaration to Banque de France for France-versus-foreign transactions of EUR 50,000 or more per settlement; (ii) French foreign-investment screening requiring prior Treasury authorisation where a non-EU/EEA investor acquires control of, or more than 25% of the voting rights in, a French entity active in a sensitive sector listed in Article R. 151-3 CMF (which may include critical public-health manufacturing); and (iii) tax friction on profit remittance, namely the French statutory dividend withholding tax of 25% for corporate non-residents, reduced to 0% under the EU Parent-Subsidiary Directive or to treaty-reduced rates, plus the 30% flat tax applied to distributions beneficially held by individuals. None of these hurdles prevents euro-denominated profit remittance.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Not applicable. France imposes no statutory export-proceeds surrender, no mandatory euro conversion ratio, and no time limit for retaining export receipts abroad. Proceeds from ICU ventilator government contracts may be kept in EUR or foreign currency in any licensed bank account, including non-resident accounts. Compliance is limited to (i) monthly balance-of-payments declaration to Banque de France for export settlements of EUR 50,000 or more, filed by the SAS or its reporting bank with supporting invoices and export customs documentation; and (ii) the French bank's standard documentary verification of the underlying commercial transaction under AML/KYC rules. LC proceeds are credited net of commissions without any forced conversion.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Rating: Medium for small-value operational disbursements and FX conversion; Low for capital escrow, large trade settlement, and government LC operations. Legal constraints: ACPR-licensed electronic-money institutions and payment institutions (e.g., Qonto, Shine, Revolut Business, Wise) are not credit institutions under Directive 2013/36/EU; they may not take deposits, grant credit, issue or confirm documentary letters of credit, or provide regulated account-pledge or escrow services. A French capital escrow for a SAS must be held with a credit institution or notaire. EMIs also lack the native SWIFT-correspondent and Banque de France balance-of-payments reporting interface expected by French authorities, and their transaction ceilings are generally inadequate for multi-million-euro government tenders. They should be used only as a supplementary payment wallet, never as the primary treasury bank.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Under Article L. 561-5 CMF and ACPR guidance, the SAS, its legal representative (president), and all beneficial owners holding 25% or more must be identified before account opening. For a non-resident-owned SAS in the medium-risk-enhancement category (medical-device manufacturing), French tier-1 banks require at least one in-person or bank-supervised video-conference interview with the legal representative; remote-only opening is permissible only where the signatory is authenticated with a qualified eIDAS electronic signature and an ANSSI-certified video-identification process. In practice, physical attendance at the bank's commercial centre in Paris, or at the bank's foreign branch with a local KYC officer, is the standard for non-EU shareholders. Where the president is a non-EU individual, the bank will demand a passport with apostilled notarial copies and proof of professional address. The physical-presence requirement is generally waived only for legal representatives already holding a French professional residency or where the bank has an existing private-banking relationship.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident sole shareholder structured through an offshore or opaque SPV with unclear ultimate beneficial ownership
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Apostilled or consular-legalised certificate of incorporation of the shareholder; updated French Registre des Beneficiaires Effectifs (RBE) extract of the SAS; UBO declaration form of the shareholder; OECD CRS tax self-certification; tax-residency certificate of the shareholder; group-structure memo demonstrating economic substance; audited financial statements of the shareholder; and a professional bank reference from the shareholder's home-country bank.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Legal representative (president) with no French tax or residential nexus, raising straw-man-management concern
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Extrait Kbis of the SAS showing valid appointment; apostilled notarial copy of the president's passport; proof of professional address and sector background in life-support or ICU medical devices; criminal-record extract (bulletin n. 3 or equivalent) dated less than three months; curriculum vitae and prior board mandates; certified copy of the statuts demonstrating the president's authorised signing powers; where the president is a legal entity, its RBE extract and the delegated representative's powers.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax return (liasse fiscale, Cerfa 2065-SD and supporting schedules)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFIP) through the French e-filing tax portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Calendar-year fiscal year: 31 May for e-filed returns; paper filers must file by the second working day after 1 May. Non-calendar fiscal year: no later than three months after fiscal year-end.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of 10% of the income tax due; penalty increases to 20% if no return is filed after formal notice or 40% in cases of deliberate concealment; late-payment interest accrues at 0.40% per month; habitual non-filing can trigger automatic tax assessment and seizure proceedings.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual financial statements deposit (dépôt des comptes annuels)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registry Clerk of the Commercial Court (Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce) through the INPI 'guichet unique' formalities portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: The shareholders' annual general meeting must approve the annual accounts within six months of fiscal year-end; the approved financial statements must be filed with the registry within one month after approval, i.e. generally within seven months of fiscal year-end.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Persistent non-filing exposes the SAS to a court-ordered filing under daily penalty payments (astreinte), criminal fines for directors up to EUR 9,000, and eventual administrative strike-off (radiation) from the Trade and Companies Register.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual confirmation of beneficial owners (déclaration de bénéficiaires effectifs)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: INPI — French Register of Beneficial Owners (Registre des Bénéficiaires Effectifs) via the guichet unique
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: At least once per calendar year on the anniversary of the original UBO declaration; any pre-existing change in beneficial ownership must be filed within 30 days of the change.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file or update beneficial-owner information after formal demand incurs a fine up to EUR 3,750 for individuals and EUR 18,750 for legal entities; deliberate false disclosure can lead to five years' imprisonment and a EUR 75,000 fine under Article L. 561-60-1 of the French Monetary and Financial Code.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Statutory auditor's report on annual accounts (Commissaire aux Comptes opinion, when audit threshold is triggered)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Presented at the annual shareholders' general meeting; the signed report is filed alongside the annual accounts with the Registry Clerk
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: The audit must be completed in time for the general meeting approving the accounts within six months of fiscal year-end; the auditor's report accompanies the accounts filed within one month after that approval.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to appoint a statutory auditor where legally required can invalidate the shareholders' approval of the annual accounts and expose the managing directors and auditors to criminal penalties under the Commercial Code, including fines and imprisonment for certifying accounts that do not fairly present the financial position.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A statutory auditor (Commissaire aux Comptes) is mandatory for a SAS where at least two of the following three thresholds are exceeded at fiscal year-end: balance-sheet total greater than EUR 4.0 million; net turnover excluding taxes greater than EUR 8.0 million; average permanent workforce greater than 50 employees. Appointment is also compulsory if the SAS controls another legal entity, is controlled by another legal entity, or holds more than 20% of the share capital of another company.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: French GAAP (Plan Comptable Général, ANC Regulation 2014-03) for unlisted SAS; IFRS optional for non-listed entities. The statutory accounts of a French SAS must be prepared under the PCG and presented on the liasse fiscale submitted to DGFIP.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: A French SAS must maintain an accurate register of direct and indirect beneficial owners and confirm its correctness at least once a year on the anniversary of the original declaration. Share transfers trigger a specific 30-day update obligation only when the transfer changes the actual legal or economic ownership pattern; the annual confirmation applies even when no transfer has occurred.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of members (share ledger with transfers and capital history)
Register of directors and corporate governance minutes
Minute book of shareholders' and management board decisions
Register of beneficial owners (RBE) kept on physical or electronic premises

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 25% (Article 219 I CGI; all categories of profit for financial years opened on or after 01 January 2022)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Reduced IS rate of 15% on the first EUR 42,500 of taxable profit (Article 219 I-b CGI) for qualifying small enterprises whose turnover is below EUR 10 million; Research Tax Credit (CIR) at 30% of eligible R&D expenditure up to EUR 100 million and 5% above; Innovation Tax Credit (CII) at 20% up to EUR 400,000 of eligible SME expenditures; supplementary social contribution (contribution sociale) of 3.3% on IS when group turnover exceeds EUR 7.63 million; optional 3-year tax loss carry-back (crédit d'impôt de report en arrière) capped at EUR 1 million.
corporate_income_tax_regime.tax_loss_carryforward_detail: 0 signifies indefinite carry-forward under French law: deficits may be carried forward without any statutory time limit, but the annual deduction is capped at EUR 1 million plus 50% of the portion of taxable income exceeding EUR 1 million (Article 209-I CGI). A carry-back option of 3 years is available up to EUR 1 million of creditable loss.
corporate_income_tax_regime.group_tax_filing_note: The SAS may integrate a French tax consolidation group (intégration fiscale, Articles 223 A to 223 L CGI) if it holds 95% or more of its French subsidiaries; intra-group transactions are neutralized for consolidation purposes.
